methodology.integerSemantics: unsigned modular arithmetic at the selected width
methodology.timeouts: One budget for submission+receipt per transaction, and one for final receipt through validated plaintext; input preparation has its own budget.
methodology.timing: Monotonic wall time. Input preparation is excluded from transaction-to-result and included in end-to-end when performed inside the request.
methodology.postReceipt: Receipt-pinned read + authorization + SDK/network/service wait + decryption + validation; not isolated FHE compute time.
methodology.computeSetup: Every compute replicate uses fresh encrypted inputs, all decrypted/validated before its measured transaction. State is populated separately.
methodology.chain: Each step waits only for the preceding receipt; only the final result is decrypted. First step resets the accumulator from input[0].
methodology.load: Separate platform windows, fixed total requests, C independent accounts, closed-loop one logical request per account; load then add = two transactions/request. No repeat-ready decryption.
methodology.import: Imports validate all N inputs; CoFHE view decrypts them sequentially and Zama uses one batch. Post-receipt costs include this SDK difference.
methodology.warmup: One validated request per case/account excluded from measurements. Failed warmup/setup is retained and blocks that case/platform, not unrelated cases.
methodology.failures: All attempts retained. Only administrative post-receipt timeouts are completion censoring. Ambiguous transactions halt the affected account without resubmission.

units.throughput: validated logical requests per second; receipt transactions also reported
